# Storefront Sales Dataset (dummy)

Aggregated monthly sales by product category for a fictional retailer, 2023 to 2025.
No customer-level records are included.

## Columns

- `month`: first day of the month, ISO 8601
- `category`: product category
- `units`: units sold
- `revenue_sgd`: revenue in Singapore dollars, before GST
